explosion.about: big fireball explosion with debris and shockwave

blood-splash.about: dark red splash (keep it brief, not gory)

heal-glow.about: healing / recovery aura rising around someone (continuous)

black-hole.about: swirling dark vortex with a hot ring (continuous)

meteor.about: burning meteor streaking down (pos = start; flies along dir)

dust-burst.about: dust puff from a landing / impact on the ground

energy-charge.about: glowing power charging in a hand (continuous, put pos at the hand or use attach)

punch-impact.about: hit landing on a body/object: spark ring, glow pop, dust, hard shake (pair with shot.impact + speedlines)

ground-slam.about: superhero landing / ground pound: crater dust blast, flying debris, shockwave ring, huge shake

speed-dash.about: super-speed dash: wind streaks + dust kicked up behind (pos = start point; pair with shot.afterimage + horizontal speedlines)

power-aura.about: power-up aura flaring around a character (continuous; use attach: 'hero.hips' or pos at the character)

energy-beam.about: energy blast fired along +x from pos (continuous between start/end; rotate the scene setup or pos to aim)

teleport.about: teleport in/out: flash, sparkle burst, ring
